changes: Only the three explicitly authorized REMAINDER-03 aliases normalize to their original fixed-model panel; original attempt labels remain visible.
Distinct attempted conditions, actual attempts and independently audited valid outcomes are separate; engineering interruptions cannot make a panel complete.
Repeated valid outcomes are rejected rather than selecting the better attempt; collection and scientific exclusions remain outside autonomous counts.
Missing audits, short probe windows and nonfinite probe values cannot support success or silently improve episode-macro means.
The middle SSH hop no longer receives the local PC's connection-cache pathname; strict known host keys and configured aliases remain required.
The original 20-second file RPC deadline now covers nonblocking pipe writes as well as response reads; partial bytes continue the same request without replay.
last_allocation_preconditions: Read the exact existing job 670729 native terminal/final state, actual update and query intents.
Read actual Core terminal adjudications, process identities and physical reservations.
Settle actual native cost before releasing any reservation.
Bind only never-started or eligible settled-engineering conditions; preserve every valid failure and success.
Use the same original E1 authority, T0, admission cutoff, total GPU/CPU/update caps and at most the last third PBS submission.
